answer_1.quote: We evaluate both the base and finetuned versions of VLMs using MMHalBench, Object HalBench, and AMBER, which are standard benchmarks for assessing hallucination and the quality of generated text of VLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include descriptions of images and answers to visual questions, such as identifying objects, their attributes, and spatial relationships.

answer_2.quote: We report the CHAIR metric to measure object hallucination and the MMHalBench score (computed via ) to quantify the quality of generated outputs.
